note: The first twelve input bytes are read into buffer; the candidate starts with the W64 marker bytes so later dispatch selects the W64 parser.
The input-controlled first four bytes equal the W64 riff marker, causing SF_FORMAT_W64 to be returned.
The W64 parser requests a 16-byte hashed marker followed by an 8-byte size from the same short input stream.

When fewer bytes than requested are available, header_read returns the short count without copying into the caller buffer; the caller's temporary buffer must have been initialized before use but was not.
The failed short read leaves the stack array sixteen_bytes holding indeterminate bytes for the h conversion.
The h conversion hashes all sixteen bytes even though header_read did not initialize sixteen_bytes, triggering an uninitialized read.
